_about: Word lists for the summary writer (Layer A). Everything is matched case-insensitively as whole words in the note the person typed or spoke. Add words here; no code change needed. Transliterations (Telugu, Hindi…) and common misspellings are included on purpose. Short abbreviations that are also ordinary words (be, me, ma, it, get, sales, bank…) are left out on purpose: they match too often. Add the full phrase instead.

experience._note: workedAfter: words that follow a role and mean the person DID that work ('delivery boy ga pani chesanu', 'electrician ka kaam kiya')

wantedRole._note: triggers come BEFORE the role (English: 'want a driver job'); triggersAfter come AFTER it (Telugu / Hindi / Tamil / Kannada word order: 'driver job kavali', 'AC technician banna chahta hu')
